issue.title: [Frontend] Settings submit button disappears after a failed update
issue.body:
## Summary
When saving settings fails, the Update Settings button remains hidden and the user cannot retry without editing a field or reloading.

## Reproduction steps
1. Apply demo/bugs/frontend-settings.patch.
2. Run `Set-Location target-app; npm test -- --run frontend/src/components/SettingsForm/SettingsForm.test.jsx`.
3. Observe that the retry button cannot be found after the rejected request.

## Expected behavior
The Update Settings button becomes available again after a failed request.

## Actual behavior
The button remains hidden.

## Environment
Local target app test suite.
